title: ci(app-shell): give the test-project tsc an 8192 MB heap; it peaks at ~4.2 GB against the 4096 MB cap
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu8tnV1vNd5XEZLc7qizriZS)_

Closes #32794

## 维护者速读
- 问题：main 的 Type Check UI 里 `@object-ui/app-shell#type-check` 在 4096 MB 堆上限处 OOM（exit 134），合并队列 PR 会被随机踢出。
- 原因：`type-check` 第二段 `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`（6529 个文件、约 80 万行）冷缓存实测堆用量 4228912K，正好贴着 4096 MB 上限。
- 改动：只把这一段的 `--max-old-space-size` 调到 8192（`packages/spec` `check:test-typecheck` 的先例）；第一段 `tsc --noEmit` 实测 2.4 GB，保持 4096。
- 余量：8192 下实测峰值 RSS 约 4.4 GB；CI 的 ubuntu-latest 有 16 GB，turbo 并发 4，实际占用几乎不变，只是放开了上限。
- 影响：仅 package.json 的 scripts 字段，不改任何运行时字节，不加 changeset（`skip-changeset`）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## Evidence (cold cache, deps built, `tsconfig.tsbuildinfo` deleted)
| run | heap cap | Memory used (`--extendedDiagnostics`) | peak RSS | exit |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tsc --noEmit` (tsconfig.json) | 4096 | 2480363K | — | 0 |
| `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` | 4096 | **4228912K** (at the cap) | — | 0 (barely) |
| `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` | 8192 | 4401415K | 4432 MB | 0 |

- `pnpm --dir ui --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` after the change, cold: exit 0 (1m56s).
- CI budget: Type Check UI runs `turbo run type-check --concurrency=4` on `ubuntu-latest` (4 vCPU, 16 GB). Raising a cap does not raise use: the run needs ~4.4 GB whatever the cap, so 8192 fits next to three other tasks.
- Gates: `dispatch-gates --commands` 32 run, `--ran` 0 NOT-MEASURED 0 UNRUN; app-shell `pnpm lint` exit 0 (0 errors).

## Acceptance notes
- Branch is the harness branch `claude/project-thread-unhf8h`, not `claude/issue-32794-…`.
- No changeset: the diff is the `scripts` field of one package.json and publishes no behaviour; label `skip-changeset`.
- app-shell vitest not run: no source or test file changed.
